label: Market Close
headline: S&P 500 +1.6%, Nasdaq +2.3%, 10y 4.94% +9bp, gold $3,669; best S&P week since April 2025
stance: Stocks and Treasury yields rose together into the 1:00 close. Chip stocks led the rebound from November's selloff.

bullets: Yields rose with stocks. 10y closed at 4.94%, near the day's 4.94% high.
